Name: Tucky
Tagline: Notes docked to your screen edge, with an AI agent inside
Description: Tucky is a native macOS notes app that sleeps as a thin stripe on the screen edge. Local and encrypted. Plus is $12/month for voice, connectors, and the best LLM models.

Name: Sciptly
Tagline: An iOS teleprompter app controlled by your voice
Description: Write, organize, and record videos effortlessly with Scriptly. Featuring real-time voice-following scrolling, local storage privacy, and professional teleprompter tools. Download the public beta on TestFlight.

Name: Assist
Tagline: Voice annotate your Mac, get screenshots + clipboard manager
Description: Annotate your Mac screen with voice, capture full-screen screenshots, and keep copied text ready to reuse from the notch.

Name: PR Lens by Coldtea.ai
Tagline: See code through a new lens
Topics: Open Source, Software Engineering, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: PR Lens is a new way to look at code. It draws animated architecture and data flow diagrams of any codebase and every pull request, so you see the change before you read a single line of code. It runs as a GitHub Action, on the CLI, or as a skill for your coding agent. Open source under MIT.

Name: Airuncode
Tagline: Run multiple local coding agents on your machine
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Airuncode is a local-first agent runtime for serious software work. Run multiple coding agents on your machine, bring your own API keys, switch between cloud and local models, and pay providers directly with zero token markup. It scans your codebase, debates solutions across agents, edits files, runs tests and self-heals failures. It also ships with V-CORE, a native Vulkan 3D runtime for AI-assisted game development. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Name: Nina by Antalpha
Tagline: Non-custodial AI Agent: research, predict & trade crypto
Description: Nina is a non-custodial AI trading assistant by Antalpha (NASDAQ: ANTA). Unlike generic chatbots, it's wired to institutional-grade, real-time data and answers conclusion-first, with charts—not walls of text. Ask in plain language; Nina drafts the trade, prediction, or safety check—you sign on your own wallet. One chat now covers crypto and US stocks: market intel, smart-money tracking, predictions & Polymarket, wallet-safety checks—plus Sentinel 24/7 alerts and MCP for any AI client.

Name: Remind
Tagline: Full-screen meeting reminders with AI briefings
Description: Remind puts your next meeting on every screen, with an AI briefing on who you are meeting and a one-click join button. Stay focused until it is time to join. Connect Google or Microsoft calendars and bring relevant email, Slack, and Notion context into your meeting prep. For macOS 14+. $19.99/year with a 7-day free trial.

Name: Routines by Databox
Tagline: An AI Analyst that runs analysis and reports on a schedule
Description: Give your AI Analyst a prompt and a schedule. It analyzes your live data, prepares the report or analysis you asked for, and delivers it by email, Slack, or in-app. The recurring work you do by hand today gets done automatically.

Name: Clipnote
Tagline: Save your AI conversations so they persist after closing tab
Description: Your ChatGPT and Claude conversations disappear the moment you close the tab. With Clipnote, just tell your AI to "save this" and it's kept on the spot — pasting it in works too, of course. It's a place to keep your AI conversations like a notepad, come back to them later, and pick up right where you left off.

Name: Bloop
Tagline: Turn any Mac audio into a visual you can actually export
Description: Bloop turns system audio or mic input into eight real-time shader skins - every frame reacts to what's actually playing. Keep it beside your work in the resizable Mini Player or send it to the menu bar. Drop in an MP3 playlist and export the whole thing as a finished video. Apple Silicon, notarized, no subscription. Two skins are free forever, and they're the full app, not a trial.

Name: Dash to Cart 2.0
Tagline: Hyperlightweight DTC commerce with built-in discovery
Description: Dash to Cart 2.0 is rebuilt from the ground up to keep commerce lightweight. Launch your store, get discovered through Dash to Cart Discovery, sync eligible products with Google Merchant Centre, manage Stripe-powered payments and refunds, and handle tax, shipping, and pickup in one place. Add deeper analytics, sales forecasting, email open tracking and expanded AI tools. All in one connected DTC commerce system.

Name: Beauty Finder
Tagline: Top beauty products, picked by pros on Instagram & TikTok
Description: Pick a beauty category and our AI ranks the products professional makeup artists actually recommend on Instagram and TikTok, with the videos as proof. Free to run.

Name: Capslane
Tagline: Reliable YouTube transcripts through one API
Description: Capslane gives developers a stable API for YouTube transcripts. It returns native captions when available and automatically generates a timestamped transcript when they are missing. Get plain text or structured segments, choose a language, manage API keys, inspect usage, and connect through JavaScript, Python, MCP, or n8n. Start with 50 free requests each month.

Name: Marchh
Tagline: Turn walks and runs into territory on a shared map
Description: Marchh turns real-world movement into something you can see on the map. Walk or run, close a route, and qualifying GPS activity becomes virtual territory on a shared map. Track distance and pace, explore territory ownership, and watch the map change as people move. Unlike a traditional fitness tracker, Marchh makes movement feel like exploration and a game. Available now on iPhone.

Name: tokenchit
Tagline: Turn your AI coding history into a shareable repo card
Description: tokenchit reads your local Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode logs and renders one embeddable card straight into your repo. A file you commit, not a URL you depend on.

Name: VulX Watch
Tagline: Catch security risks hiding in your vibe-coded apps
Description: VulX Watch continuously checks AI-written code for security risks like committed secrets, vulnerable dependencies, fake packages, injection patterns, and SQL/RLS issues. Connect a GitHub repo or MCP to get clear findings with evidence, severity, file locations, and suggested fixes. Built for AI-generated code, VulX never rewrites, runs, or tests your app, it reads, verifies, and surfaces what needs attention inside Claude or Cursor.

Name: BLINDER
Tagline: Pocket 3D mesh modeling tool for mobile creators
Description: BLINDER is a mobile 3D editor designed for Android, allowing users to create, view, and tweak 3D graphics on their smartphones without the need for a PC. Perfect for indie game developers, designers, and 3D enthusiasts who want to model shapes on the go.

Name: FaceBubble
Tagline: Your face in a bubble over any app. Free, no watermarks.
Topics: iOS, Video Streaming, Social media marketing
Description: FaceBubble records your face in a floating bubble over any app on your iPhone. Record or go live to Twitch, YouTube and Facebook. Completely free - no watermarks, no limits, no subscriptions.

Name: Cantrip AI
Tagline: Write a min-app into existence. Draw a glyph to cast it.
Description: Describe a small app you want. A stretch timer that hums every 30 seconds. A tally for cups of coffee. An AI living on your phone creates it, offline. Then you draw a glyph, and that glyph is how you open it from then on. The home screen is a canvas: scratch the mark, the tool appears. Nothing leaves the device, nothing is a template, and anything you don't like you can change by asking. Cantrips are small enough to make on a whim and personal enough to keep.

Name: Lexfall
Tagline: Speak like you belong in the room.
Description: Lexfall is a minimalist vocabulary app for professionals who already speak well. Speaking English is not the same as speaking your profession's English; when high-stakes decisions are being made, nuance is everything. If you are relying on basic vocabulary, your true expertise gets lost. Lexfall delivers B2–C2 words across Medicine, Law, Business and General English through a home-screen widget that teaches you a new word every few hours. Now on the App Store.
